question: Which original object observations support the proposed Kanmer pendant/pass use, and which handling experiment can test suspension?
outcome: Four photographed clay pendants, three restored registrations with dimensions/mass/context, seven registered comparison-frame objects with 25 captioned scanner views; 2012 authorcopy acquired and a 42-replica suspension/handling design specified.
challenge: Fourth registration, raw meshes, individual hole measurements and wear are missing; original-three context descriptions differ; PDF resource order initially misassigned six figure captions.
remedy: Preserve source-relative faces, use numerical-caption stem joins, separate group and individual context statements, correct extraction by page positions in a separate endpoint, and state the original scanner method and remaining measurements.
retry_when: Original 2009 article, final-volume physical/object pages, object context register, fourth registration or raw scanner meshes provide new observations; physical replicas can then test resting orientation and wear.
local_inputs: Detailed object/face records and all third-party witnesses are local-only. Tracked source manifests, source coordinates, summaries, code and aggregates support future acquisition.
